largestModuleEvidence.exactAttribution: Not generated in Concept 7F; the build warning and source import graph were inspected instead.
largestModuleEvidence.why: The audit objective is product/UX prioritization. A precise module treemap would be useful for a later performance phase but is not needed to establish that rare workflows are eagerly loaded.
largestModuleEvidence.doNotClaim: This artifact does not claim that one named dependency is the numerically largest module.

perceivedPerformance.initialLoad: Potentially heavier than a conventional CRUD app because map/GIS, all panel code, RF visualization, research, validation, reports, and local persistence are loaded in one application chunk.
perceivedPerformance.mapLoad: Map is central and should remain prioritized; dataset and building overlays can make first meaningful map interaction feel expensive.
perceivedPerformance.datasetSwitch: Visible dataset/status messaging exists, but there is no single shared progress model across map load, dataset switch, and panel readiness.
perceivedPerformance.simulationStart: Strong explicit status vocabulary: Evaluating, Simulating, Optimizing, Analyzing, and related states.
perceivedPerformance.optimizationStart: Explicit activity states exist; result/Pareto transition is dense rather than silent.
perceivedPerformance.scenarioSwitch: Snapshot restoration and rerun requirements are communicated in some flows; the lifecycle is not persistently visible.
perceivedPerformance.runHistoryOpen: Local records should be fast, but detail metadata is dense and lacks a compact skeleton/summary state.
perceivedPerformance.reportsOpen: Report generation is explicit; export and retained-artifact code is eager even before the Report tool is opened.

classification.severity: measurable startup issue, not an emergency
classification.reason: The warning is real and a single 252.89 kB gzip JS payload is meaningful, but the higher-risk user problem is current/stale/historical lineage. Performance work should follow a safe product-boundary decision.
